notes.title: SPLICE CONTEST ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.content:
[b]CONTEST ANNOUNCEMENT!  Write in Comments what would be the wildest combination of TWO animals? Myself and two other judges will choose two winners. Both winners will have their animal animated to be in my upcoming game Apocalypse Blitz. 
This Contest begins 9/20/2023-10/04/2023. Winners will be announced on 10/07/2023. Now get to Splicing![/b][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44153617/38bac36e3c4d6935b02552fcc6a5d7b6143c8260.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Apocalypse Blitz Demo Now Available for Download
notes.content:
[b]Play as the Angel Jystus in this exciting level! Do the Bully Slide and more to defeat the Apocalypse enemies. Contact me and comment on any bugs, issues and feed back is welcomed.[/b]

[b]I plan to showcase more of the game and one showcase will be about the enemies.  Also, with the upcoming crowd funder, you can have an option to create your own enemy in the game[/b].[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44153617/983c6253353aae83ea2d55f05e73f083affd8dbc.png[/img]
